newsitem.title: USA: US Northeast spot power quiet in pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: US Northeast spot power quiet in pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. Tuesday remained unchanged from Monday in very light, pre-holiday activity.
"We're seeing prices the same as yesterday," a Houston marketer said.
Wholesale power business was very light with a number of regional utilities closed today and Wednesday in observance of Christmas.

Temperatures in the Northeast were expected to drop about 10-15 Fahrenheit degrees overnight due to passage of an Arctic cold front. Weather in New York and New England would stay colder-than-normal in the 20s-30s for the rest of the week.

Mild weather pushed natural gas prices lower again today. Swing natgas prices at the New York City gate slipped to the $4.10-$4.16 per million British thermal unit (mmBtu) range from Monday's $4.28-$4.30. Today'a assessment was off almost a dollar from Friday.
A couple of key nuclear power plants in the region were in the process of resuming production this week.

The 1,137 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Nine Mile Point nuclear power facility in Scriba, N.Y., was running at low output, about 10 percent power, following its weekend restart. The unit was shut last week for repairs.

The 832 MW James A Fitzpatrick nuclear plant, also in Scriba, N.Y., achieved operation at 800 MW capacity, and expected to stay at that level until the end of the year. The upstate New York station was shut December 15 to repair a leak in the electrical hydraulic control system.
Peak, non-firm electricity prices for Thursday delivery in the western part of the New York Power Pool (NYPP) held at $20.00-$22.00 a megawatt hour (MWh).
Off-peak, non-firm power for next-day delivery in western NYPP remained in a notational range $15.00-$16.00.
In eastern NYPP, Thursday's peak, non-firm power was still pegged at $26.50-$28.00/MWh.
Eastern NYPP electricity for off-peak, non-firm delivery Thursday stayed at $18.00-$19.00.
In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), peak, non-firm electricity for Thursday at Northeast Utilities' (NU) border were held at $30.00-$33.00.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for Thursday delivery to the NU border was still assessed at $20.00-$22.00.
